Songs.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: My songs. Continue first, then folders as rows, then every song with its engraved cover. Chips pick the place, search and Sort and filter narrow it, the heart favourites, + adds

SongsLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: My songs. The library tree is the places; Continue as four covers; a table of only the columns that hold something; Add sits in the bar so nothing covers the table; Sort and filter opens in place

Song.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: a song's page. The first bars as its cover, Edit beside the title, Learned and the heart at the bar's right, Key · Time · Tempo once, Chords to tap, Your practice, Details; Continue and Play float

SongLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: a song's page in two columns: the song on the left, Chords, Your practice and Details on the right; Continue and Play float under them

Editor.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: editing the score. One quiet bar (Done, Undo, Redo, the piano, Play, ···); the score; Flat's palette folded to one row of tools over its tabs, the grip opens every section in one scroll; the keys under it

EditorLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: editing the score. The page in the middle, the palette docked at the right with every section in one scroll, the piano from the bar

Main.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Practice. Up next first (one thing to start, two after it), then Harmony, Playing and the Tools last, each row with a picture of what it holds; Tools is a real menu in the bar

Laptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Practice. Up next across the top, then each group as four cards with a large picture

Chords.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Chords. The chord first (its name, how it is written, its notes, on the staff); Root, Chord and Voicing as pickers; Inversion and Hands; Fingering by hand; Colour notes to add; Practise this chord in the Player. Play and Arpeggio sit over the keys, which carry no finger numbers

ChordsLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Chords in three columns: what you build on the left, the chord in the middle with Play and Arpeggio, Colour notes and Practise this chord on the right; the keys across the foot; the gear opens Chord settings

Scales.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Scales and keys. Tonic and Scale as pickers; the scale engraved with its fingers (Degrees or Steps); Scale · Chords · Key tabs say what they hold; fingering by hand as the books print it; Play up and down with its tempo over the keys

ScalesLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Scales and keys in three columns: the choices on the left, the scale and its tab in the middle, Play with tempo and Practise this scale on the right

Intervals.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Intervals. From (a root) and Play as; the interval chosen as the page's hero (its name, semitones, the staff, what it sounds like, songs that open with it); Simple · Compound; every interval a row to tap; Play and Play all over the keys

IntervalsLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Intervals. The list on the left, the interval chosen on the right with Play, Play all and Train your ear; the keys across the foot

Progressions.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Progressions as a library in the app's library shape: search with Sort and filter, place chips (All, Favourites, Recently played, Mine), what the colours mean, styles that fold with counts, every row's numerals coloured by role, a heart; + adds

ProgressionsLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Progressions with the library tree (places and styles with counts) and a table of name and chords; Add in the bar

Progression.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: a progression's page. Its style, name and sound; Key, Numerals of, Voicing; the chords as tiles coloured by role with the root's move between them; About, Practise it, More like it; Play with tempo over the keys

ProgressionLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: a progression's page with the chords on the left and About, Practise it and More like it on the right

Accompaniment.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Accompaniment as the Pattern library: search with Sort and filter (Sort by, Level, Texture) and removable chips; place chips for each book; folders that fold (Recently used and Favourites open), Open all; rows with the pattern's roll, hands, level, Listen and the heart; a tap opens the pattern

AccompanimentLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Accompaniment with the library on the left and the pattern chosen on the right: its roll, hands, how to play it, Listen, Practise in the Player

ChordPlayer.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: the Chord player: the sheet's title in the bar with Undo, its gear and ···; Style, Key and Tempo; sections that move by their grip, repeat × n, bars four to a row (a bar can hold two chords); a tap on a chord opens it (the key's chords, root, chord, length, bass note, Delete with Undo); Play and Loop above the keys, which show the chord sounding

ChordPlayerLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: the Chord player with the sheet on the left and Style, Key, Tempo, Instruments and Chord names on the right; the key's chords below to drag into a bar; a chord opens in a popover; Play and Loop above the keys

Exercise.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: an exercise's page (Hanon): its book, what it trains, its first bars engraved; Number, Key (root grid and Next key), Hands, Rhythm, Tempo and Target tempo with how near you are; Completed today; Technique; Listen and Start above the keys. The Exercises library is Accompaniment's (row 7), one implementation

ExercisesLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Exercises as the library on the left (place chips by book, folders, the heart) and the exercise chosen on the right, Listen and Start above the keys

Quiz.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Quiz: My gaps first, then the trainers by what they ask, each with its best score ringed and its runs; a trainer opens its setup (Drill: Flashcards · Name it · Play it · By ear with ⓘ, Level, Options, Rounds, Timing, Start); a run: Round 3 of 10, the chord on the staff and the keys, four answers, the verdict and Next

QuizLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Quiz with the trainers on the left and the chosen trainer's setup on the right, Start at its foot

Metronome.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Metronome: the tempo large with −10 −1 +1 +10 and its Italian mark, a slider and Tap tempo; the beats as squares, tapped round Accent · Beat · Silent; Time signature, Sound, Subdivision; Speed trainer and Silent bars as pages; one Start

MetronomeLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Metronome, the same, laid out across the screen

Tuner.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Tuner: a gauge from −50 to +50 cents, the note large, In tune · Flat · Sharp, cents and Hz; the keys show the note heard; the microphone asked for in place; Reference pitch in its settings

TunerLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Tuner, the same, laid out across the screen

ChordFinder.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Chord finder: Spelled in a key (root grid); the chord named large with Play, in words and as a numeral; its notes with their degrees and which is in the bass; Also read as; the chords played; In these keys; Clear the keys and Open in Chords above the keys; Try a chord when empty

ChordFinderLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Chord finder, the same, laid out across the screen

CircleOfFifths.dc.html.title: iPhone 17 Pro: Circle of fifths: the circle with major keys outside, minors inside and each signature; a tap chooses a key and lights its neighbours; the key's signature, relative minor and diatonic chords by role; Open in Scales and keys

CircleOfFifthsLaptop.dc.html.title: MacBook Air: Circle of fifths, the same, laid out across the screen
